summary: The bedroom is well kept, but exposed hot bulbs and top-heavy accents pose minor hazards.

hazards.title: Low Exposed Light Fixture Bulbs
hazards.detail: Bare pendant bulbs hang near the foot of the bed, posing burn and contact fire risks.
fixSteps: Swap incandescent-style bulbs for cooler LED bulbs immediately.
Shorten the hanging rod to ensure safe overhead clearance.

hazards.title: Unanchored Nightstand Table Lamp
hazards.detail: Tall bedside lamp sits near edge without stability aids and can tip easily.
fixSteps: Apply museum putty or adhesive pads beneath the lamp base.
Route the power cord securely to avoid snagging when in bed.

hazards.title: Floor-Length Drapes Near Window
hazards.detail: Deep hanging curtains near window opening could present catch or egress hazards.
fixSteps: Install curtain tiebacks to keep the window area clear and accessible.
Ensure window latches and safety stops are functional behind drapes.

products.name: Museum Gel Putty
products.reason: Secures bedside lamps to tabletop surfaces to prevent knock-overs.

products.name: Cool-Touch LED Filament Bulbs
products.reason: Eliminates excessive heat output from exposed chandelier sockets.
